summary: Iteration 11 regression re-run after main agent's fix for cross-org role leakage. All 19 iteration_10 tests now PASS (previously 18/19), including the previously-failing TestRoles::test_roles_org_scoped_isolation. Verified via curl that GET /api/roles response now exposes org_id on every role (11/11 roles have org_id set to caller's org). No regressions observed in the auth/students/roles-CRUD/orgs/invites/is_live/map-detach flows. The 4 pre-existing legacy failures in backend_test.py (unrelated schema: original_show_id / additional_show_ids / link_timestamp / groups) are unchanged from iteration_10 and were explicitly scoped out by the request.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cross-org role isolation fix is verified. Next iteration can safely trust that: (1) POST /api/roles stamps org_id from the caller, (2) new orgs clone only Default Org's is_system=true built-ins, (3) GET /api/roles never leaks other orgs' custom roles.
